# The Grey Pilgrim — ผู้เดินทางชุดเทา (Multi-Domain Psychological Reflection Platform)

> Thai-language psychological self-reflection, life-cycle decoding, 78-card Tarot cognitive reframing, and Hall-Van de Castle dream analysis platform.

## Core Principles
- Non-superstitious framing: All insights are psychological reflections, behavioral pattern observations, and cognitive reframes—never guaranteed prophecy, fate prediction, or medical diagnosis.
- Privacy & Compliance: PDPA Section 26 explicit consent gating before personal reflection or optional sanitized Gmail theme extraction.

## Three Domains Served From Shared Architecture
1. **Life-Cycle & Transit Decoder (DuangTok)**: Seasonal Thai psychological reflections, cognitive-bias awareness, and personalized crossroads analysis.
2. **Tarot Reflection Decoder (The Grey Pilgrim / ผู้เดินทางชุดเทา)**: Complete 78-card psychological Lore Library (Light vs. Shadow reflections) and pre-reveal free-association multi-card readings.
3. **Dream & Night-Omen Decoder (FanRai)**: Sleep continuity guides plus Hall-Van de Castle (HVDC) quantitative metrics and Clara Hill 3-stage reflection.

## Key Routes
- `/` — Active domain broadsheet, free articles, and interactive Reading Studio
- `/lore` — Full 78-Card Tarot Psychological Lore Library
- `/sitemap.xml` — Dynamic per-domain XML sitemap
- `/robots.txt` — Crawler policy
